description: MRPC BLB baseline fixed action. Use CLI --range/--action-fixed to sweep precise truncation or scaling-factor points.
notes: This file intentionally contains no ranges, so command-line fine-grained selectors are not multiplied by a preset sweep.
The model-side base action is the BLB RL baseline action: all non-truncation fields use their highest selectable action-space scaling-factor settings.
The optimizer-side mode is baseline: Rescale_optimizer uses its static baseline chain/t_new/delta settings instead of deriving a new chain from the max action.
